shelf.title: My Shelf
shelf.lead: Read the manga you couldn't read, one page at a time.
shelf.emptyText: Add a series, drop in your screenshots, and start translating.

series.name: Series name
series.emptyText: Add an episode, then drag your screenshots onto it.
series.dropHint: Drop screenshots here, or use “Add screenshots”.

reader.noPages: This episode has no pages yet.
reader.holdHint: Hold Space to peek at the original · ← → to turn pages
reader.notTranslated: Not translated yet, showing the original

glossary.title: Glossary & rules
glossary.lead: Confirmed terms are used exactly as written in every translation. The model can't change them.
glossary.changedHint: Changed a term? Press “Retranslate” on the series page to apply it to finished pages.
glossary.pendingLead: New names found while translating, with a suggested translation. They're fixed once you confirm them.
glossary.emptyText: New names and places will show up here for you to confirm.
glossary.rulesHint: Speech habits, honorifics, how each character refers to themselves. Sent with every translation.
glossary.summaryHint: Add a short paragraph after each episode so the model knows what happened.

settings.title: Settings
settings.gpuCpu: No NVIDIA card found. Running on the CPU (several times slower per page).
settings.claudeMissing: Claude Code isn't installed. Translation needs it.
settings.claudeLogin: Not signed in. Run claude in a terminal and follow the steps.
settings.nightModeHint: Deep cocoa background, easier on the eyes at night
settings.languageHint: Only changes the interface, not the translation language
settings.assetsLead: Illustrations, the mascot and icons can all be replaced with your own images (SVG, PNG, WebP). Images that don't match are scaled to fit and centered.
